definitions.explanation: The time following an event or action.
What is left over; the remaining portion.
The position or location at the rear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{後|あと}、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{昼寝|ひるね}→昼寝：00106_hirune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After lunch, I took a short nap.

examples.japanese: {後|あと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{連絡|れんらく}します。
{後|あと}⟦{五分|ごふん}→五分：09573_gofun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{終|お}わる。
examples.english: It will be done in five more minutes.

examples.japanese: {後|あと}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll come later. / I'll follow behind.

notes:
{後|あと} is a common word meaning "after" or "remaining."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {後|あと}で (later)
- 〜の{後|あと} (after ~)
- {後|あと}から (afterward, from behind)
- もう{少|すこ}しの{後|あと}で (in a little while)
- あと〜 (~ more, remaining ~)

"REMAINING" USAGE:
- あと{五分|ごふん} (five more minutes)
- あと{三|みっ}つ (three more)
- あとは〜 (as for the rest...)

CONTRAST:
- {後|あと}: everyday/spoken style
- {後|のち}: formal/written style
- {後|ご}: in compounds ({食後|しょくご}, {午後|ごご})

NOTE: Not to be confused with {跡|あと} (trace, mark).
